message.content:
Camp Nou’s official seated capacity is **about 99,354** spectators – the maximum number of seats currently installed following its most recent major refurbishment completed in 2019.  

Historically the ground could accommodate roughly 100,000 people when standing areas were still used, but modern safety regulations and all‑seated configuration bring the figure down to the present 99,354 mark.
